title: Rasm-e-Duniya Ko Todna ⛓️
hook_line: Kya aap bhi ek purane raste par chal rahe hain, ya kuch naya banane ki himmat rakhte hain?
caption:
Kya aap bhi kisi purani parampara ko tod kar apna rasta bana rahe hain? ⛓️

Faiz Ahmed Faiz ki ye nazm un sab ke liye hai jo bheed se hatkar kuch alag karne ka hosla rakhte hain. Share karein unke saath jo aaj apne sapno ke liye lad rahe hain.

Save this for your daily reminder of courage.
meaning_note: Ye sher un logon ke liye hai jo 9-5 ki bheed se hatkar apna kuch naya banana chahte hain—unke liye jo 'rasm' (tradition) todne ka hausla rakhte hain.
reasons: Massive demand evidence (millions of views) for this specific poetic sentiment.
The 'non-traditional path' angle is a perfect fit for the struggle of balancing a 9-5 with business building.
Strong emotional payoff regarding courage and breaking conventions.
